edges.action: Choose Add column

edges.action: Open Configure

edges.action: Inspect Argon web research configuration and enter approved prompt
edges.postcondition: Research configuration and prompt visible

edges.action: Type / in prompt and choose <SOURCE_COLUMN>
edges.postcondition: Actual row-field token appears in prompt

edges.action: Turn column Auto-run off
edges.postcondition: Auto-run visibly disabled

edges.action: Save without running, then inspect stored configuration
edges.postcondition: Saved prompt tokens, model, output fields and Auto-run-off confirmed

edges.action: Select and run no more than five intended rows
edges.postcondition: Bounded selected rows completed and output cells read back

edges.action: Configure direct native AI copy column bound to verified row research and approved offer; disable Auto-run and save without running
edges.postcondition: Saved copy column has actual row tokens and Auto-run off

edges.action: Run no more than five selected copy rows; verify grounding and missing-input behavior
edges.postcondition: Per-row copy outputs read back, failures retained, nothing sent

edges.action: Choose <CSV_PATH> with Browse files in native picker
edges.postcondition: Expected filename shown

edges.action: Inspect destination and column mapping
edges.postcondition: Expected mapping and target confirmed

edges.action: Complete authorized import with automation disabled; read back destination
edges.postcondition: Expected count, stable row IDs and values verified

edges.action: Do not use Sculptor
edges.postcondition: Forbidden by standing user instruction

edges.action: Do not send, launch, activate, or schedule campaigns
edges.postcondition: Forbidden: copy remains draft output

edges.action: Click 'Find leads', then under 'Search directly' the 'People' button
edges.postcondition: Find leads menu visible

edges.action: Click People under Search directly
edges.postcondition: URL is /chats/<cc_id>, Find People heading

edges.action: Click Chat tab, set the textarea to <ICP_SENTENCE> with the native value setter, dispatch input, press Enter
edges.postcondition: 'Search is ready.' and '~N found' in Preview

edges.action: Click Continue
edges.postcondition: radio inputs value=all|custom and table

edges.action: Pick custom with <ROW_LIMIT> or all, pick table, click Save
edges.postcondition: Enrich people screen lists per-row costs

edges.action: Click the Work email option, click 'Save and run 10 rows'
edges.postcondition: Table URL /workbooks/<wb>/tables/<t> with Find work email columns

edges.action: Click the 'Find work email' header, hover 'Run column' (pointerover + ArrowRight opens the nested menu)
edges.postcondition: 'Run N empty or out-of-date rows' with credit total

edges.action: Navigate to /campaigns/<CAMPAIGN_ID>
edges.postcondition: Status Draft, Lead setup count equals the intended people count

edges.action: Click 'Launch sequence'
edges.postcondition: Dialog reads 'includes N leads'; N must equal the people count

edges.action: Click 'Confirm and launch' only after a full pre_send_gate pass
edges.postcondition: clay campaigns get shows active; analytics totalLeads equals N

edges.action: If analytics totalLeads stays 0 while Lead setup shows N: Pause > Pause sequence, then Resume > Resume sequence
edges.postcondition: totalLeads becomes N (observed 2026-10-06: 0 to N after one pause and resume)

notes: Observed edges reflect the live operator session handoff on 2026-09-23, not an authenticated witness or independent replay. Import and save/run/copy completion remain documented. Equal unit costs are unmeasured planning estimates. Coverage is limited; no mastery claim. Private evidence is not included.
